# Heading with a [link](https://example.com) and `code`

A paragraph with *emphasis*, **strong**, ~~strike~~, `inline code`, a [link](https://example.com) and a footnote[^1].

- first item
- [ ] task item
- [x] done item

1. one
2. two

> A regular quote.

> [!NOTE]
> Note text.

> [!TIP]
> Tip text.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Important text.

> [!WARNING]
> Warning text.

> [!CAUTION]
> Caution text.

| Name | `code` |
|---|---|
| a | `b` |
| [link](https://example.com) | d |

```go
// main prints a greeting.
func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello", 42)
}
```

[^1]: The footnote.
